privacy.crashLogsDesc: Send sanitized error locations, version and platform to the maintainer to diagnose failures. No manuscript text is included. You can turn this off at any time.

privacy.diagnosticsDesc: Copy version, platform, feature availability, sync counts/error categories, and update state. It contains no manuscript, credential, project identifier, or absolute path and is never uploaded automatically.
privacy.noteLocal: This build never contacts a Drifting server; your work stays on this device. AI and voice-transcription requests go straight from this device to the provider you chose, under that provider's data and training terms; remote MCP extensions you add also use the network.

projection.description: Every project has structured Markdown for local reading, search and external tools. Chapters and ideas can be edited in any editor and merge back while Drifting runs; other files are generated and read-only.

projection.offHint: Off: projects no longer write Markdown and outside edits no longer merge back. Existing files stay where they are.
projection.offWarning: No project writes Markdown anymore. Other editors and external Agents keep seeing today's files, and edits made there no longer merge back into Drifting. Existing files stay where they are; turn it back on in Settings → Sync & Data.

update.check_failed: Couldn't check for updates right now, perhaps there is no connection. Try again later; this version keeps working.
update.install_failed: Drifting {{version}} couldn't be installed when you last quit. This version is unchanged; it tries again next time you quit.
update.install_failed_admin: Drifting {{version}} couldn't be installed when you last quit: the folder Drifting is in can't be written to. This version is unchanged.
update.interrupted: The update didn't finish downloading and was discarded. It downloads again at the next check.
update.local_error: The update couldn't be saved on this computer and was stopped. This version keeps working.
update.older_offered: You're up to date. The update service offers {{version}}, which is older than this version, so it won't be installed.
update.ready_on_quit: Drifting {{version}} is downloaded and its signature verified. It installs when you quit.
update.refused_app: The downloaded update isn't Drifting and was discarded. This version keeps working.
update.refused_signature: The downloaded update failed signature verification and was discarded. This version keeps working.
update.refused_version: The downloaded update isn't the version it claims to be, possibly an older one, and was refused. This version keeps working.
update.server_error: The update service has a problem right now. Try again later; this version keeps working.
update.unavailable: This build has no updater signing key, so it cannot check for updates. Releases downloaded from GitHub can.
